payload.title: Check the approval flow in real browsers before the first live proof
payload.description: From the security review of #2 (finding 4). The pages now send form-action 'self' plus the sign-in provider's origin, because Chromium applies form-action to the 303 that follows the approve POST. Prove the whole approve, sign-in and callback flow in current Chrome, Safari and Firefox on a test deployment (cookies with the __Secure- prefix, SameSite=Lax on the return from Cognito, CSP) before any product's first live proof.
